messages:
sam: heads-up: deploy-bot flagged apigw-canary -> HOLD after surge of 502/504s around 01:02UTC. This is blocking 2025.04.01-roll. @antoine @ops-oncall can you triage?

deploy-bot: [automated] HOLD applied by policy: elevated gateway errors from canary. Release slot: 2025-04-01T01:00Z. Suggested actions: pin failing component, run diagnostic smoke, propose new slot.

antoine: looking at metrics now. Connection timeouts upstream to session-store in eu-west. Replica lag on the new read-replica after the migration. Canary nodes are hitting stale shard mappings and timing out.

ops-oncall: confirmed replica lag ~18s during the window. No impact to general production traffic (only canary routing). Appears to be a configuration mismatch in the replica promotion script used in the last infra change.

lina: recommendation: 1) pin apigw component to previous config (config v4), 2) revert read-replica promotion script to v1, 3) reschedule canary to next off-peak (04/02 03:00 UTC) for a smoke run after fixes. Also add a pre-flight check that ensures replica lag <5s before canary traffic switches.

sam: agree. We should prevent accidental rollforward. Please add a pin and create a short rollback note.

antoine: I'll run the pin and revert steps. Commands:
```
# pin apigw back to config v4
/releasebot pin 2025.04.01-roll --component apigateway --config v4
# revert replica promotion script
git revert --no-commit 4b7a9f2 -- scripts/replica_promote.sh && ./deploy-scripts/run-patch.sh --staged
```
I'll also add: "Reverted read-replica promotion change and pinned API gateway config due to transient replica lag causing 502/504 in canary."

releasebot: action: pin recorded by antoine at 1800000010. Canary hold remains. Next candidate slots: 1800086400 (2025-04-02 03:00 UTC), 1800172800 (2025-04-03 03:00 UTC).

kevin-eng: vote for 04/02 slot. We should also tighten the gate for canary: require replica lag <5s AND p99 latency <800ms for 10m before traffic shift.

ops-oncall: ack. I'll add the pre-flight checks to the canary pipeline and schedule an automated smoke run: `scripts/canary_preflight.sh --region eu --checks lag,p99 --thresholds 5,800`. Alerts to #eng-oncall if fail.

lina: please make the smoke assert zero 5xx errors and validate session-store replicas are in-sync. If any flake, escalate and keep hold.

sam: thanks all. I'll draft the release note and internal blurb for customers saying we paused a canary due to replica lag; no customer-facing degradation observed.

antoine: pin & revert applied. Monitoring shows replica lag returning to baseline. Will run the preflight tomorrow and report back.

sam: locking the thread. If preflight passes we'll move to the 04/02 slot; if not, we'll extend fix window and notify sales/support. :white_check_mark:
